_comment: Difficulty curves (calibrated with tests/balance_sim.tscn -- career). xp: XP needed to go from level L to L+1 = base + per_level x (L-1) + per_level_sq x (L-1)^2 (LevelSystem). enemy_floor_mult: enemy stat multiplier for floors 1..25, on top of their level (floor + 1); beyond the table the last step repeats (EnemyFactory.get_base_multiplier). Calibrated so a smart solo player who keeps gear current clears floors 1-3 ~85% first try, 4-10 ~75%, 11-20 ~65%, 21-25 ~55% (docs/balance/DIFFICULTY.md).
_class_skill_levels: Levels at which a hero learns their class's 1st, 2nd and 3rd skill (classes.json skills, in order). A rookie starts with one.
